exec: Binance says it has finished restoring withdrawals after the October security incident, per Crypto.news; a few networks remain under maintenance or scheduled upgrades.
geo_basis: no place stated in the sources
plain: Crypto exchange Binance says it has finished restoring withdrawals after its October security incident. Some blockchain networks are still under maintenance or scheduled upgrades.
summary: Crypto.news reports that Binance said on 26 November that work to restore withdrawals after the October security incident was complete. According to the article, Binance said a small number of networks remain under maintenance or scheduled upgrades and account for a very small share of normal withdrawal traffic. The report is based on Binance's statement; Binance's own post was not read.
title: Binance says work to restore withdrawals after October security incident is complete, per Crypto.news

validation.note: Single publisher (Crypto.news) quoting Binance's statement; Binance's own post was not read and Techmeme is only an aggregator link.

review.note: Compared title, date, small-share wording against Crypto.news; different development from theft event
